summary: Group network devices by what, where and when, avoid spaces, hyphens and leading digits, and use children to create metagroups; a YAML and INI example builds leafs, spines, network and datacenter groups.
questions: How should I group switches and routers in Ansible inventory?
How do I make a group containing leafs and spines?
How do I write a leaf-spine inventory?

answer_card.title: Basic network inventory
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
leafs:
  hosts:
    leaf01: { ansible_host: 10.16.10.11 }
    leaf02: { ansible_host: 10.16.10.12 }
spines:
  hosts:
    spine01: { ansible_host: 10.16.10.13 }
network:
  children:
    leafs:
    spines:
webservers:
  hosts:
    webserver01: { ansible_host: 10.16.10.15 }
datacenter:
  children:
    network:
    webservers:
```
INI equivalent uses `[network:children]`. Group by what/where/when; no spaces, hyphens or leading digits; names are case sensitive.
